title: Isolation precautions

findings.where: Images 4 and 11; step "cdiff" caption and narration; fact 9
findings.title: “On the exam, the answer is soap and water” is an unsupported guarantee
findings.problem: The narration turns a commonly taught preference into a universal NCLEX answer rule. Hand-hygiene questions still depend on what the stem asks, including timing, contamination and applicable guidance. The subsequent practice-policy caveat does not undo the instruction to answer differently merely because it is an exam.
findings.fix: Remove the categorical exam claim. State that soap and water physically removes spores and is commonly emphasized after C. difficile care in nursing exam preparation; tell students to apply the question’s circumstances and their current course references. Preserve the distinction that alcohol-based hand rub is not sporicidal.

findings.where: Images 7 and 14; step "transport"; focus array and Explainer scroll behavior
findings.title: The transport lesson starts below two unnecessary full precaution rows
findings.problem: The step repeats the complete droplet and airborne panels before showing the transport panel and caption. At phone width, these repeats consume most of a typical viewport. Explainer scrolls to the section’s top, so narration can begin while the transport instructions and most of their caption are below the fold.
findings.fix: Focus the transport panel instead of repeating both full rows. Put compact masked-client illustrations beside it, explicitly labeled as client source control. Keep the transport instructions and the beginning of their caption visible together when the step opens.

assessment: Needs revision: the C. difficile step teaches a categorical exam-answer shortcut, and the transport step buries its actual teaching content below repeated material.
